title: Pigeons
description: Pigeons, as a pigeons video preset, is a city takeoff: a stable person and a flock bursting as confetti, wings filling the air, then settling. The flock is the move, and the person is the hold.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: City punctuation: a meeting that scatters, a fashion frame that needs weather, a square that panics and looks like joy. The still is the peak of the takeoff, face visible through wings.
Three birds on a ledge is not the recipe. The air should be mostly pigeon.
It is the wrong tool indoors, and the wrong tool if you freeze the birds unless you mean frozen-in-motion of a flock. If the camera tours the square, you lost the gag.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Chest height to slightly low in a plaza, 24mm to 35mm so wings occupy volume. Lock-off or Handheld that does not chase every bird.
Key is hard sun or stone bounce. Write a burst of wings around a stable figure, feathers as particles.
Prompt still: Pigeons bursting around [Subject], a city takeoff, wings as confetti, the square exploding into birds. Motion: A flock explodes around [Subject], wings filling the air, then settling.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Mary Poppins uses a square of birds as urban weather around a person. Plaza takeoffs in crime films, including The Godfather's public spaces, treat a flock as sudden public panic.
Grammar of air, not a frame to copy.

blocks.text: Three birds, or a face lost in a cloud, or a cut to Particles glitter. The tell is a ledge with pigeons sitting.
Fix it: burst, volume of wings, stable figure, peak of takeoff.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Pigeons in film?
A named flock gag: a still person, a square exploding into birds, wings as confetti. The flock is the motion. The camera mostly holds.
Pigeons vs Particles
Particles is dust, sparks, pollen, a weather of bits. Pigeons is animal takeoff with wings and panic. If the bits have no anatomy, you wanted particles.
When should I use Pigeons?
City punctuation and plaza scatter. Skip interiors and any still of three birds sitting.
How do I prompt Pigeons for AI image or video?
Plaza, stable [Subject], then: Pigeons bursting around [Subject], a city takeoff, wings as confetti, the square exploding into birds. For video, the flock explodes and settles. Keep the face.
